note: Open predictions matched to similar prediction markets. 'side' is which market outcome the host's call needs: yes or no. 'fit' is 'same' when the market asks the same question as the scoring rule, 'close' when it is only the nearest market; 'gap' says how it differs. Plain links only: no referral codes, no money from any venue.
